title: Security Headers Validation
summary: All required security headers are now applied to every HTTP response from the CourtAccess backend.

headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* ws://localhost:*; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
headers.productionValue: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.courtaccess.com wss://*.courtaccess.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
headers.purpose: Restrict resource loading sources to prevent XSS

headers.name: Strict-Transport-Security
headers.purpose: Enforce HTTPS for all connections (1 year)

headers.name: X-Frame-Options
headers.purpose: Prevent clickjacking by denying iframe embedding

headers.name: Referrer-Policy
headers.purpose: Control referrer information sent with requests

headers.name: Permissions-Policy
headers.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=()
headers.purpose: Disable unnecessary browser features (camera, mic, etc.)

headers.name: X-XSS-Protection
headers.purpose: Enable XSS filter in legacy browsers

apiCacheControl.purpose: Prevent caching of sensitive API responses

productionOverrides.Content-Security-Policy: Tightened CSP: removes unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval for scripts, restricts connect-src to *.courtaccess.com

productionRecommendations: Remove 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' from CSP when React build uses nonces or hashes
Configure Nginx to also set these headers at the reverse proxy level for defense-in-depth
Register domain for HSTS preload list at hstspreload.org
Add Expect-CT header if using Certificate Transparency logs
